{{Quote|I'm chief scientist at ChemFlex doing research for the Republic. Or I was.|Rassan|<ref name="TOR:LA" />}}
'''Rassan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He used to be a chief scientist of the [[ChemFlex]] company. While on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he warned a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizen about an enemy attack on his lab, which was researching deadly biological weapons.<ref name="TOR:LA" />
